Uniform birth-time parity interpolation is the main diagnostic; constant-post-cell sensitivity retained. Model household reproductive member is not certified female exposure; no empirical age reweighting.

First-birth flow timing, not completed-cohort timing. Household maternal proxy; empirical under-18/over-45 tail collapse retained; raw builder residence and unknown-order comparability remain unresolved.

First-birth flow timing, not completed-cohort timing. Household maternal proxy; empirical under-18/over-45 tail collapse retained; raw builder residence and unknown-order comparability remain unresolved.

Household net worth is scaled by reference-person-plus-spouse gross labor earnings; calendar-specific wealth valuation and earnings-reference-year alignment remains inherited from the PSID shelf and is not newly certified.

Experimental approximation: the frozen model observer sums positive estates over all fertility/dependent-child states without child-recipient eligibility or allocation, whereas the adopted SCF ratio is child-directed. No recipient-law change is authorized in this contract.

Uniform within-age-cell overlap for ages 76--84 Modeled pension plus configured lump-sum income proxy; not PSID total family income Empirical $1000 real-income and observed-child-history filters are not reproduced At these retirement ages model denominator is pension income (including configured z scaling), while PSID INCFAMR also includes transfers, asset income and other family components. Exact $1000 cutoff is not applied (only income>0), and observed-completed-children selection has no model missingness counterpart. Full 78/82 cells do not cover exactly 76-84. Actual model property-tax lump-sum transfer is zero in this receipt; proxy uses the configured pension-plus-transfer concept.
Uniform model exposure within four-year age cells; literal AHS ROOMS has public-use topcode 21. Model rooms are uncapped. Housing supply normalization remains an empirical normalization.

National ACS target geography is accepted. The empirical owner sample is restricted to DUE structures UNITSSTR 3:10, a structure-type distinction absent from the model state; age 30-55 is projected through a four-year model cell extending to ages 54-57.
The stationary first-birth housing observer approximates this empirical event-study contrast and does not reproduce the Sun-Abraham panel estimator or its baseline-status cohort selection.

National ACS target geography is accepted. Empirical groups use NCHILD=3+ versus 1-2 and require YNGCH<18. Model dependent-child count m is only a proxy: it can differ from resident own-child count and does not guarantee the ACS minor-child restriction.

warning.declaration: Synchronized post-fertility snapshot; uniform head-age overlap; model dependents proxy resident own children; actual current births from previously empty-dependent homes versus current empty homes inclformerparents. Not an exact annualACS interview reconstruction.

model_observer_warnings.warning: Observed completed age 25 corresponds to [25,26). Fixed uniform birth-time interpolation in [22,26) uses post weight .875 and literal ever-born weights [0,1,2,3]. Household reproductive-member exposure is not certified female exposure. Bootstrap is not CPS design-consistent.

policy_array_gates.interpretation: Adjacent-wealth screen on occupied pre-choice states; fixed-age/income/tenure/family comparisons. A flagged drop requires diagnosis, not automatic attribution to an economic mechanism.

receipt.policy_plot_scope: Standard saving/consumption panels are buyer-conditional; stayer policies retained separately
